About.intro: This is an anime search application built as part of the <course>RS School React Course</course>. It allows you to search for anime titles using the <api>Jikan API</api> — an unofficial MyAnimeList REST API. For now it includes features like pagination, search history persistence, and error handling. The project is built with the following technologies:

tech.name: Next.js (App Router)
tech.description: for server-side rendering and static generation
